weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，你可能會發現你的財務狀況出乎意料的好轉。可能是您的一些投資意外飆升，或者您所在地區的房地產升值超出您的預期。無論是哪種情況，請先抵制提領的衝動。價值可能會繼續攀升。保持耐心，讓您的資產蓬勃發展。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, you might find your finances taking an unexpected turn for the better. It could be that some of your investments unexpectedly surge in value, or perhaps the properties in your area are appreciating more than you anticipated. Whatever the case may be, resist the urge to cash out just yet. The likelihood is that the value will keep climbing. Stay patient and let your assets flourish.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天可能標誌著一個徘徊了一段時間的法律問題的解決，結果可能對你有利。如果您有合同、協議或任何重要文件等待簽署，請在承諾之前花點時間仔細審查。您可能會從這筆交易中獲得有利的結果。此外，今天是結婚的好日子！
taurus.horoscope_en: Today could mark the resolution of a legal issue that has been lingering for some time, Taurus, and the outcome is likely to be positive for you. If you have a contract, agreement, or any important document awaiting your signature, take the time to review it thoroughly before you commit. You’re likely to achieve a favorable result from this transaction. Additionally, it’s an excellent day for tying the knot!

gemini.horoscope: 今天，雙子座，你充滿了活力，是走出家門，擁抱世界的完美時機。透過進行扎實的鍛煉來優先考慮您的身體健康。如果有機會，不妨考慮一日遊或參觀遊樂園。這種能量的激增是一種罕見的禮物，所以抓住時機，盡情享受吧！
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you’re brimming with vitality, making it a perfect time to step outside and embrace the world. Prioritize your physical well-being by engaging in a solid workout. If the opportunity arises, consider a little adventure—maybe a day trip or a visit to an amusement park. This surge of energy is a rare gift, so seize the moment and enjoy it to the fullest!

cancer.horoscope: 今天，巨蟹座，當你遇到一個有趣的人時，你可能會體驗到激動人心的身體吸引力。請注意，不要讓自己的感受過於公開，因為你通常更喜歡隱藏自己的情緒。你不會想太急切的！保持腳踏實地，保持清晰的視角。之後，花點時間思考探索這個新發現的景點是否明智。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you might experience a thrilling surge of physical attraction when you meet someone intriguing. Be mindful not to let your feelings show too openly, as you typically prefer to keep your emotions under wraps. You wouldn’t want to come across as too eager! Stay grounded and maintain a clear perspective. Afterward, take a moment to reflect on whether it’s wise to explore this newfound attraction.

leo.horoscope: Leo ，今天你可能會發現自己專注於處理待辦事項清單上揮之不去的家務。一位女性旅人（可能是你的母親）可能會拜訪你，提示你整理旅居。但是，請記得節奏，避免過度勞累；當她到達時，您會想要有足夠的精力來享受她的陪伴。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might find yourself focused on tackling household tasks that have been lingering on your to-do list. A female guest, possibly your mother, may pay you a visit, prompting you to spruce up your space. However, remember to pace yourself and avoid overexerting; you’ll want to have plenty of energy left to enjoy her company when she arrives.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天是解決你一直拖延的關鍵電話的完美日子。在深入其他任務之前，請先安排這些對話的優先順序。您目前的溝通技巧特別敏銳，確保您的訊息能夠清晰地產生共鳴。無論您是透過電話聊天還是製作訊息，充滿情感的話語都會促進與他人的深層聯繫。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, today is the perfect day to tackle those crucial phone calls you've been putting off. Prioritize these conversations before diving into other tasks. Your communication skills are particularly sharp right now, ensuring that your message will resonate clearly. Whether you're chatting on the phone or crafting a message, your words infused with emotion will foster a deep connection with others.

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會發現自己興奮不已，因為積極的財務消息會照亮你的家庭生活。這可能會激勵你將一些新發現的財富用於改善生活空間。也許您正在考慮搬家，甚至購買新房。雖然腦力激盪各種方式來利用這種財務提升很有趣，但請記得要謹慎行事。明智的做法是留出一部分資金用於未來的安全保障。
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might find yourself buzzing with excitement as positive financial news brightens your home life. This could inspire you to channel some of that newfound wealth into enhancing your living space. Perhaps you're contemplating a move or even the purchase of a new home. While it's fun to brainstorm various ways to utilize this financial boost, remember to exercise caution. It's wise to set aside a portion of that money for future security.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，一個迷人的新鄰居，可能是吸引你眼球的人，可能正在靠近你。這可能會為您的一天帶來驚心動魄的轉折。您可能會進行對話，並在交流中找到樂趣。決定是否進一步探索這個景點將取決於你各自的情況，但無論如何，你一定會建立新的友誼。
scorpio.horoscope_en: A captivating new neighbor, possibly someone who catches your eye, may be moving in close to you, Scorpio. This could bring a thrilling twist to your day. You’re likely to engage in a conversation and find pleasure in your exchanges. Deciding whether to explore this attraction further will hinge on your respective circumstances, but regardless, you’re bound to forge a new friendship.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你的直覺可能非常敏銳。你可能會意外地發現自己對未來有令人振奮的心靈見解，這可能會非常令人興奮。這些啟示可能會點燃靈感的火花，激勵你在生活的各個領域取得非凡的成就。擁抱這種潛力，因為它可能會導致自我實現的預言！抓住機會！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, your intuition is likely to be exceptionally sharp. You may find yourself unexpectedly tapping into uplifting psychic insights regarding your future, which could be quite thrilling. These revelations might ignite a spark of inspiration, motivating you to achieve remarkable things in various areas of your life. Embrace this potential, as it could lead to a self-fulfilling prophecy! Seize the opportunity!

capricorn.horoscope: 朋友可能會向你介紹一個有趣的人，摩羯座，你可能會在看到他們的照片時感到強烈的身體吸引力。最初的聊天可能會令人興奮，但保持冷靜並保持頭腦清醒是很重要的。如果你的情緒太過明顯，就有可能在任何東西開花之前將它們嚇跑！保持真誠，享受對話，享受美好時光。這就是你現在所需要的一切。
capricorn.horoscope_en: A friend might introduce you to someone intriguing, Capricorn, and you may feel an intense physical pull upon seeing their photo. The initial chat could be thrilling, but it's important to keep your cool and maintain a level head. If your emotions are too apparent, you risk scaring them off before anything can blossom! Just be authentic, relish the conversation, and have a good time. That's all that's required from you right now.

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你可能會發現自己在職業生涯中取得了一些令人興奮的進步。無論您是剛剛完成一個重要的裏程碑，還是獲得了一個幸運的機會，表明您的願望比以往任何時候都更接近，這都是值得慶祝的一天。期待從一些令人驚訝的來源聽到讚美的話，甚至你的財務狀況可能會有所提升。無論如何，你真的配得上這次的成功！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you might find yourself soaring with some thrilling advancements in your career. Whether you've just accomplished a significant milestone or received a fortunate opportunity that signals your aspirations are closer than ever, it’s a day to celebrate. Expect to hear words of praise from some surprising sources, and there may even be a boost in your finances on the horizon. Whatever the case, you truly deserve this success!

pisces.horoscope: 親愛的雙魚座，今晚不妨考慮參加一個以哲學或精神主題為重點的舒適聚會。房間裡的能量可能會被充電，每個人都熱情地參與對話，進行令人興奮的想法交流。當你回家時，你的思緒可能會急轉彎，所以如果可能的話，散散步來幫助你清除思緒。之後記下您的反思；您需要捕捉這些見解。
pisces.horoscope_en: This evening, consider joining a cozy gathering focused on philosophical or spiritual themes, dear Pisces. The energy in the room is likely to be charged, with everyone passionately engaged in the conversation, making for an exhilarating exchange of ideas. By the time you head home, your thoughts may be racing, so if possible, take a stroll to help clear your mind. Jot down your reflections afterward; you'll want to capture these insights.
